title: Concatenation of last chunks
statement: Let $w$ be a bit string and $N$ a natural number with $|w|\le N$. For each $i=0,\ldots,N-1$, take the last chunk of the suffix of $w$ beginning at position $i$, and concatenate these chunks in order. The result is the one-term list containing the last bit of $w$, or the empty list if $w$ is empty.
